workflows.name: Curate the object set
steps: filter the collection and open the object editor
validate and persist a new artifact
expose the object to the journey planner
workflows.success: the validated object appears in the collection and remains after reload
workflows.failure: field-level errors prevent invalid or duplicate records from being saved
workflows.verification: Playwright creates an object through the collection route and verifies its persisted card

workflows.name: Build and validate the visitor journey
steps: place or move it through a state command
workflows.success: the artifact appears in the target zone and updated metrics are visible
workflows.failure: invalid placement is rejected and an actionable constraint message remains visible
workflows.verification: Playwright assigns an object to a zone and verifies placement and recalculated analysis

workflows.name: Run a review to readiness
steps: advance the finding through allowed states
run readiness rules and export a snapshot when eligible
workflows.success: resolved findings are recorded and readiness shows a stable outcome
workflows.failure: illegal transitions and unresolved blockers prevent ready state and snapshot export
workflows.verification: Playwright creates, advances, and resolves a finding, then runs the readiness check

workflows.name: Compare planning scenarios
workflows.success: projection metrics update and applied preferences persist
workflows.failure: out-of-range inputs are constrained and baseline state remains intact
workflows.verification: Playwright changes scenario controls and verifies projected duration and applied state
